variable {G A : Type*} [Group G] [AddCommGroup A] [DistribMulAction G A] [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace G]
  [MeasurableSMul G A] {μ ν : Measure A} {g : G} [TopologicalSpace A] [BorelSpace A] [IsTopologicalAddGroup A]
  [LocallyCompactSpace A] [ContinuousConstSMul G A] [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ν.IsAddHaarMeasure] [Regular μ] {s : Set A}
informal_statement: Given a set \( s \) with a non-zero and finite measure \( \mu(s) \), and for a function \( h \) satisfying \( \mu(g \cdot s) = r \cdot \mu(s) \), we aim to show that the distribution property of the Haar character associated with \( A \) at \( g \) equals \( r \).
informal_proof: To prove this, we first note that \( \mu(s) \) is both non-zero and finite, allowing us to utilize the definition of the Haar character distribution. By substituting the given condition \( \mu(g \cdot s) = r \cdot \mu(s) \) into the definition, we simplify the expression using basic algebraic properties. Specifically, we apply the principle that multiplying a quantity by \( r \) and then dividing by the same \( r \) cancels out the multiplication, leaving the original quantity. This algebraic manipulation directly yields the desired result, \( \text{distribHaarChar}(A)(g) = r \).

id.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.distribHaarChar_eq_of_measure_smul_eq_mul
id.content:

  refine ENNReal.coe_injective ?_
  rw [distribHaarChar_eq_div hs₀ hs, hμgs, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel_right] <;> simp [*]

rag.name: Real.map_matrix_volume_pi_eq_smul_volume_pi
rag.content:
/-- Any invertible matrix rescales Lebesgue measure through the absolute value of its
determinant. -/
theorem map_matrix_volume_pi_eq_smul_volume_pi [DecidableEq ι] {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : det M ≠ 0) :
    Measure.map (toLin' M) volume = ENNReal.ofReal (abs (det M)⁻¹) • volume := by
  -- This follows from the cases we have already proved, of diagonal matrices and transvections,
  -- as these matrices generate all invertible matrices.
  apply diagonal_transvection_induction_of_det_ne_zero _ M hM
  · intro D hD
    conv_rhs => rw [← smul_map_diagonal_volume_pi hD]
    rw [smul_smul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _), ← abs_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hD, abs_one,
      ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_smul]
  · intro t
    simp_rw [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.det, _root_.inv_one, abs_one, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_smul,
      (volume_preserving_transvectionStruct _).map_eq]
  · intro A B _ _ IHA IHB
    rw [toLin'_mul, det_mul, LinearMap.coe_comp, ← Measure.map_map, IHB, Measure.map_smul, IHA,
      smul_smul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _), ← abs_mul, mul_comm, mul_inv]
    · apply Continuous.measurable
      apply LinearMap.continuous_on_pi
    · apply Continuous.measurable
      apply LinearMap.continuous_on_pi

C1_dependencies.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.map
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The pushforward of a measure. It is defined to be `0` if `f` is not an almost everywhere
measurable function. -/
noncomputable
irreducible_def map [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] (f : α → β) (μ : Measure α) :
    Measure β :=
  if hf : AEMeasurable f μ then mapₗ (hf.mk f) μ else 0
